name: gamenet_unregister_gameplay_packet_handlers
description: GameNet::UnregisterGameplayPacketHandlers unregisters every gameplay packet callback and clears the gameplay handler registration flag.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet packet-handler registration source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4321b0 validates the exact zNetwork::UnregisterPacketHandler sequence for packet types 6, 7, 10, 1, 8, 9, 11, 14, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, and 19, using the corresponding gameplay handler function addresses, then clearing g_GameNet_HandlersRegistered.

The native smoke registers those handlers into a temporary zNetwork dispatch list, calls GameNet::UnregisterGameplayPacketHandlers, and verifies the dispatch list is empty and the registered flag is cleared.
